artifacts.summary: 8-phase plan to delete team mode from the source store, ordered consumer-before-producer so the orchestrator stays deployable at every phase boundary.

memory_candidates.content: When deleting a cross-cutting feature flag from a self-hosting agent system (the orchestrator being edited is the one executing the work), order phases consumer-before-producer: strip the readers (skill dispatch forks, command delegation-context keys) before the producer (the shared arg parser's exports). A parser that still exports a name nobody reads is inert; a reader whose producer vanished is broken. Give the shared parser its own single phase with Commit Mode atomic-batch so its parse blocks and export line can never be half-edited across a boundary, and defer the deploy/regeneration step to one late phase so the running deployment changes once rather than once per phase.
